name: abo-govcon-compliance
counsel_cleared_note: BLOCKED. Set to true only when contracts counsel has answered the four questions in agents/07-guardrails.md section 2, in writing. Record the date here. Professional verification required.

metric.note: all terms derive from deterministic Pass-1 extraction. MODEL-ONLY rows are never counted.

cheat_paths.path: Keyword-stuff the response so the matcher finds every shall-statement
cheat_paths.defence: per-section length ceiling, verbatim-quote checks, and the G6 human sample

cheat_paths.path: Restate the requirement as the response - matches the string, answers nothing
cheat_paths.defence: the G6 sample is specifically looking for this pattern

cheat_paths.path: Map one paragraph to twenty requirements so counts fall without content
cheat_paths.defence: max-requirements-per-response-block cap enforced in the harness

held_out.description: A human reads a random 10% sample of mapped rows and asks of each: does this actually respond to the requirement? A failed sample voids the entire run, not part of it.

stop_early_if: score reaches 0; the G6 sample then decides whether that is real
production_limits_note: Effective only once pilot.passed is true.

pilot.note: Playbook p.18. Production caps unlock only after a supervised pilot passes. A sentence in a prompt is not a hard budget - the runner needs a tested timeout, attempt counter and spend guard.
